# Can a fork PR poison your GitHub Actions cache?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find actions/cache steps reachable from pull_request_target/workflow_run, and restore-keys fallbacks that can adopt a poisoned prefix match. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
